type: ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue:
fun n j =>
  (Polynomial.C (↑n.factorial ^ 7) *
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j - Polynomial.C (↑i + 1))) *
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j + Polynomial.C ↑n + Polynomial.C (↑i + 1))
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue: fun n j => ∏ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j + Polynomial.C ↑k)
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue:
fun n j =>
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j * (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j + Polynomial.C ↑n)
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X]

definitionValue: fun n j => Polynomial.C (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) + Polynomial.C (↑n - 2 * ↑j) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.X ^ 2
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℤ[X]

definitionValue:
fun n j =>
  ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j) *
    (↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9)⁻¹
type: ℕ → ℕ → PowerSeries ℚ

definitionValue: fun n j W => ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j * ↑(W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j))
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X] → PowerSeries ℚ

definitionValue: fun n j s => (PowerSeries.coeff (9 - s)) (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j)
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ

definitionValue: fun n j s W => (PowerSeries.coeff (9 - s)) (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedClearedSeries n j W)
type: ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℚ
∀ (j : ℕ) (z : ℚ), Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedVariable j) = -↑j + z

∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j) = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.numerator n (-↑j + z)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j + z)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j) /
      Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedR n j (-↑j + z)
∀ (n j : ℕ) (z : ℚ), Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j) = (-↑j + z) * (-↑j + z + ↑n)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j =
      Polynomial.C (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) + Polynomial.C (↑n - 2 * ↑j) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.X ^ 2

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.integerLocalU n j) =
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]) (z : ℚ),
  Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j)) /
      Polynomial.eval z (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedWeightedR n j W (-↑j + z)

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.clearedPoleProduct n j (-↑j)
∀ (n j : ℕ), PowerSeries.constantCoeff ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ≠ 0

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j * ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j)

∀ (n j : ℕ) (S : PowerSeries ℚ),
  S * ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j) →
    S = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedClearedSeries n j W *
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedClearedDenominator n j) ^ 9 =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.shiftedNumerator n j * W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j))

∀ (n j : ℕ),
  PowerSeries.constantCoeff (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.clearedSeries n j) =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j
∀ (n j : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j 9 = ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.leadingPoleCoefficient n j

∀ (n j : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 9 W =
    ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedLeadingPoleCoefficient n j W

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  1 ≤ s →
    s ≤ 9 →
      ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W =
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
              (W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localU n j)).coeff (l - s)

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W =
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
                (W.comp
                      (Polynomial.C (-↑j * ↑(n - j)) + Polynomial.C (↑n - 2 * ↑j) * Polynomial.X +
                        Polynomial.X ^ 2)).coeff
                  (l - s)

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  j ≤ n →
    1 ≤ s →
      s ≤ 9 →
        ∀ (W : ℤ[X]),
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W) =
            ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
              ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
                ↑((W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.integerLocalU n j)).coeff (l - s))

∀ (n j s : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      j ≤ n →
        1 ≤ s →
          s ≤ 9 →
            ∀ (W : ℤ[X]),
              W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W) =
                  ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc s 9,
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.localCoefficient n j l *
                      ↑((W.comp (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.integerLocalU n j)).coeff (l - s))
